name: Edgur
description: A coppersmith's apprentice who bargains with the nature spirit Dare for the ability to become a bear.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgur gains the ability to turn into a bear, kills his rival Joren, and is killed by townsfolk.
timeline.quote: But the townsfolk, seeing only a dangerous predatory animal, then converge on Edgur, killing him.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Versipellis , by Paul B. Thompson". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
